headline: Piramal Pharma Raises FY27 Growth Guidance on CDMO Expansion
summary: Piramal Pharma raised its fiscal year growth guidance, driven by rising traction in its contract development and manufacturing organization business and improving capacity utilization.
why: Piramal Pharma operates contract manufacturing and pharmaceutical development services for global healthcare companies.

impacts.name: Piramal Pharma
impacts.why: Upgraded guidance indicates stronger than expected forward revenue and margin expansion.
